pages.title: SWAT: Squad Tactics
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: SWAT: Squad Tactics puts you in charge of a squad clearing rooms and rescuing hostages. Move through each location, aim at armed opponents, and interact with objects to complete the operation. Equipment choices and careful positioning help your team survive the encounters.

pages.title: Tidy Master Satisfeel ASMR
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Tidy Master Satisfeel ASMR turns cluttered scenes into organizing tasks. Tap and drag objects while cleaning locations such as beaches and gardens, with indoor, outdoor, and food themed modes offering different settings. Work through each scene by putting its contents in order.

pages.title: NinjaRoof
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: NinjaRoof challenges you to keep a nimble runner moving across a succession of rooftops. Time each jump to cross the gaps and avoid deadly obstacles. The endless course makes survival and a higher score depend on judging the next landing accurately.

pages.title: Dig out of Prison
pages.creator: IncrediGames
pages.description: Dig out of Prison combines tunnel digging with secret trading. Unearth valuables, sell your finds, and spend toilet paper currency on tools and upgrades from other inmates. Keep your escape preparations hidden so guards do not discover your equipment, tunnel, or absence from your cell.

pages.title: Acox Runner
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Acox Runner sends you through obstacle courses using jumps and slides. Choose the right action as each hazard approaches to keep the run going. Press W to jump and S to slide, or use upward and downward swipes on a touchscreen.

pages.title: Construction Set - 3D Builder
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Construction Set - 3D Builder has you assemble models by locating the required pieces and fitting them according to instructions. Work through sets depicting buildings, monuments, and characters, progressing from simpler constructions to more involved designs. Each completed assembly reveals how its individual bricks fit together.

pages.title: Beat Music Battle
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Beat Music Battle lets you combine beats into your own musical mix and create dance moves that follow the rhythm. Work through music battles and associated puzzles as you progress. The activities combine choosing musical elements with shaping the performance around them.

pages.title: Paint Tiles Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Paint Tiles Puzzle presents grids whose empty spaces need the correct colors. Fill the tiles to solve each arrangement, combining color choices with the layout of the puzzle. Use mouse clicks or taps to work through the individual boards.

pages.title: Daily Jewels Blitz Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Daily Jewels Blitz Mahjong offers a fresh arrangement of gem tiles each day. Remove identical pairs that are free on at least one side, aiming to clear the layout. Daily streaks earn rewards, while tools including hints, shuffles, and undo can help with difficult boards.

pages.title: Snowflight
pages.creator: Nexus
pages.description: Snowflight lets you guide a bird through snowy scenery, with modes for exploration, finding hidden objects, and competing in flight challenges. Move the mouse to change direction and hold the left mouse button to accelerate as you travel through the winter landscapes.

pages.title: Turbo Race 3D
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Turbo Race 3D takes highway racing through city, desert, and snowy environments. Steer around traffic, use nitro for speed, and activate a shield for temporary protection. Improve acceleration, handling, braking, and top speed between races, then personalize your vehicle with colors and decals.

pages.title: Fill Glass
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Fill Glass asks you to pour just enough liquid to reach the target level. Position the dispenser, start the flow, and stop before the glass overfills. Aim for a higher score while upgrading the pouring equipment to improve your control.

pages.title: Zombie Arena 2 Fury Road
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Zombie Arena 2 Fury Road makes your vehicle a weapon against zombies inside enclosed arenas. Drive through the undead while completing campaign objectives and clearing infested areas. Additional challenges include timed rounds, waves of enemies, and attempts to survive for as long as possible.

pages.title: Tiny Fighter - Unstoppable Run
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description: Tiny Fighter - Unstoppable Run follows a knight trying to recover a princess taken by a vampire. Jump through dangerous woods and castle passages, battle orcs and skeletons, and confront Dracula. A second click triggers a double jump to help cross the obstacles along the route.

pages.title: Hair Stack 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Hair Stack 3D has you guide a growing collection of hair through a running course. Choose numbered gates to increase the amount you carry and dodge obstacles that reduce it. Bring as much as possible to the bald head waiting at the finish.

pages.title: Save Her Tour
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Save Her Tour gives its heroine a series of dangerous situations for you to resolve. Examine each scene and solve its puzzle to keep her safe. An incorrect solution puts her in trouble, while the next level brings a different problem to work out.

pages.title: Bus Driver
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Bus Driver challenges you to collect passengers while navigating busy roads. Steer the bus through traffic and avoid crashing into other vehicles as you complete the journey. Use WASD or the arrow keys to control its movement.

pages.title: Dunk Challenge
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Dunk Challenge uses shots to propel a basketball toward the hoop. Make the ball rebound into position while conserving your limited bullets, and collect purple diamonds along the way. The shop offers alternative ball appearances, and an explosive mode adds another challenge.

pages.title: Zombie Apocalypse
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Zombie Apocalypse is a platform shooter built around running, jumping, and firing through landscapes overrun by the undead. Fight the approaching zombies while moving through each area. Unlock perks and open crates to improve your equipment for the next encounters.

pages.title: Empire of progress: Technology cards
pages.creator: Alexander Domnych
pages.description: Empire of progress: Technology cards lets you develop a civilization by unlocking technologies and improving their cards. Start with a primitive tribe and work toward space travel. Strengthening individual technologies increases the pace at which your civilization advances.

pages.title: Street Food Inc
pages.creator: Devshifu Studio
pages.description: Street Food Inc puts you in charge of building a restaurant business. Earn money from your operations, level up, and use the proceeds to expand your restaurants. Decide how to develop the business and improve its efficiency as your income grows.

pages.title: Jewel Treasure
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Jewel Treasure combines a series of jewel matching puzzles with an endless challenge. Make groups of three matching gems to work through the level progression. In endless mode, keep forming matches while dealing with a timer that becomes increasingly demanding.

pages.title: Celebrity Ari All Around The Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Celebrity Ari All Around The Fashion lets you help Ari explore several fashion trends. Browse the clothes in her wardrobe and select an outfit to suit each style. Combine the available choices to create a different look for every fashion challenge.

pages.title: Dress Up Girls
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Dress Up Girls gives you a selection of styling options for creating a girl's look. Choose among the available items and combine them into an outfit of your own. Experiment with different selections to change the finished appearance.

pages.title: Math Duck
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Math Duck combines arithmetic with timed platforming. Guide a little duck through each level, solve its equations, and reach the exit before the clock expires. Move with A and D or the arrow keys, jump with W or Up, and press R to restart.

pages.title: Skateboard Challenge
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Skateboard Challenge asks you to land tricks, reach a score target, and collect the letters spelling SKATE and COMBO. Use rails to combine maneuvers and increase your score multiplier. Gather coins along the courses to unlock additional skateboarders.

pages.title: Colors domination
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Colors domination challenges you to turn a board into one uniform color. Select blocks to change your color and spread it through the arrangement, gradually bringing the remaining blocks together. All levels are unlocked, letting you choose which color puzzle to tackle.

pages.title: Numbers crossed
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Numbers crossed replaces a crossword's words with numbers. Fill the grid with the correct numerical entries, working out how they fit into its intersecting spaces. The challenges adjust to your skill as you continue solving the puzzles.

pages.title: Cats and Dogs Puzzle
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Cats and Dogs Puzzle turns photographs of pets into jigsaws. Combine the scattered pieces in their correct positions to rebuild pictures of cats and dogs. Use the mouse to work through the images and complete each animal portrait.

pages.title: Who lives here
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: Who lives here asks you to identify the animals associated with different homes. Look at each pictured dwelling and work out which animal lives there. The questions introduce animal habitats through a series of visual matching activities.

pages.title: Rotating Catchers
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rotating Catchers puts a white balloon and a green balloon together at the center of incoming attacks. Rotate the pair to meet each approaching balloon with the same color. Keep making the correct contacts to defend the center and extend your score.

pages.title: Mountain Operation
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Mountain Operation sends you into mountainous military areas to eliminate armed opponents. Explore the terrain in third person, switch between weapons, throw grenades, and make use of military vehicles. Aim, reload, and use the surroundings while clearing each enemy position.

pages.title: Wordsoccer.io
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Wordsoccer.io turns word formation into a soccer competition. Build words from the available letters to score goals and try to finish ahead of your opponent. The game offers English and Czech word play, controlled with the mouse or keyboard.

pages.title: Tile Mahjong
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Tile Mahjong asks you to remove pairs of tiles bearing the same symbol. Select an available tile, then choose its matching partner to clear them from the board. Only open tiles can be used, so your choices depend on the arrangement still in play.

pages.title: Dolfje Weerwolfje Soup Adventure
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Dolfje Weerwolfje Soup Adventure follows Dolfje into a dangerous house in search of ingredients for a magical soup. His friend is ill, and gathering those ingredients is the reason for the visit. Use the arrow keys to explore while avoiding the house's hazards.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Memory Game
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Christmas Tree Memory Game hides decorated trees behind cards. Turn them over, remember their pictures, and uncover matching pairs to remove them. Clear each level before its time allowance runs out, using earlier reveals to locate the remaining partners.

pages.title: Rummikub
pages.creator: Kinkajoo
pages.description: Rummikub challenges you to empty your rack by arranging numbered tiles into valid color and number combinations. Select tiles and place them on the shared board while planning how to use what remains. The first player to put down every tile wins.

pages.title: Summer Midi Skirt Fashion
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Summer Midi Skirt Fashion lets you style Harley Quinn, Moana, and Mulan around a selection of skirts. Browse floral patterns, pleats, asymmetric cuts, and other designs to build their summer looks. Choose combinations for each character during the styling session.

pages.title: Hello cats
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Hello cats is a physics puzzle game where your drawings become part of the solution. Sketch shapes and use the resulting objects with the level's devices to solve each cat themed challenge. Try different drawings to change how the scene behaves.

pages.title: Mahjong
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Mahjong gives you a board of paired tiles and a time limit for clearing them. Find two identical tiles and select the pair to remove it. Keep locating matches quickly enough to finish the entire arrangement before the clock reaches zero.

pages.title: Car Race Champ
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Car Race Champ puts your chosen sports car into circuit races against rival vehicles. Drive with WASD, work through corners, and use drifts while trying to hold your speed. Balancing grip and power helps you stay competitive around the track.

pages.title: Construction Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Construction Trucks Jigsaw offers pictures of construction vehicles to rebuild from scattered pieces. Select a difficulty, then drag each piece into its correct place. There is no timer, so you can take your time working through the truck puzzles.

pages.title: Girl Beauty Shop
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Girl Beauty Shop invites you to give Masha a salon makeover. Work with the available beauty tools, change her hair, and choose makeup and clothing for her new appearance. Use the mouse to carry out the treatments and select styling options.

pages.title: Hexa Puzzle
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Hexa Puzzle challenges you to fit shaped pieces into a board until every space is occupied. Drag each piece into place and work out how the shapes can sit together. The levels provide different layouts and increasing demands on your spatial planning.

pages.title: Super Warrior Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Super Warrior Match 3 has you combine groups of at least three identical warrior icons to score points. Look for matches among the red and blue characters and keep clearing them before time expires. Your aim is to build the highest score you can.

pages.title: Stickman Differences
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Stickman Differences presents pairs of stick figure scenes with small changes hidden between them. Locate seven differences in each pair within a one minute limit. Work through the levels by comparing the details carefully and selecting the altered spots.

pages.title: Eliminate Corona
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Eliminate Corona is a puzzle game about clearing virus icons from each level. Trigger a burst and use its spreading projectiles to strike other viruses, setting off further reactions. Choose your starting point carefully to remove the arrangement with the available actions.

pages.title: Sprinter
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Sprinter challenges you to win a series of 100 meter races. Alternate the left and right arrow keys to make your athlete run, keeping ahead of the other competitors. Each victory opens a tougher race with faster opponents to beat.

pages.title: Mineblock Dragon Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Mineblock Dragon Adventure has you fly a dragon toward the end of each level. Collect dragon eggs along the route while keeping clear of obstacles and spikes. Use clicks or taps to control the flight and carry on through the courses.

pages.title: Sokoban 3D Chapter 3
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Sokoban 3D Chapter 3 presents block pushing puzzles inside a three dimensional maze. Move the red block with WASD or the arrow keys and push every blue block onto a marked position. Plan ahead, because an awkward push can leave a block trapped.

pages.title: Whack A Mole
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Whack A Mole sends moles popping out of the field for you to hit with a hammer. Click them as they appear to build your score before they hide again. Keep reacting to new targets as the round's time runs down.

pages.title: Janissary Tower
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Janissary Tower pits two players against each other from opposing towers. Fire different cannons, build bricks to improve your defenses or reach new positions, and collect bonuses from passing balloons. Red uses WASD, while Blue uses the arrow keys.

pages.title: Multi Tic Tac Toe
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Multi Tic Tac Toe lets you play the familiar contest on boards of several sizes. Take turns placing X or O in empty squares and try to complete the winning pattern before your opponent. Choose a 3 by 3, 5 by 5, or 10 by 10 field.

pages.title: Jewels Matching Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Jewels Matching Deluxe gives each level a target to reach by matching at least three identical jewels. Use special pieces such as bombs, hourglasses, and joker jewels to help clear the board. The objectives become harder as you progress through the puzzles.

pages.title: Baseball Hit
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Baseball Hit asks you to strike incoming objects with a bat while leaving the bombs untouched. Click or tap to turn the bat and time each hit. Keep destroying safe targets to build your score without making a dangerous contact.

pages.title: Stick Santa
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Stick Santa has you grow a stick to bridge the gap between platforms. Hold the screen to extend it, then let Santa walk across to the next landing. Judge the distance carefully, since a bridge that falls short sends him down.

pages.title: Lovely Christmas Toys Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Lovely Christmas Toys Puzzle 2 offers six festive toy pictures to assemble as jigsaws. Choose from four piece counts, ranging from 16 to 100, then fit the scattered pieces together. Each picture can become a shorter puzzle or a more detailed challenge.

pages.title: Christmas Ornaments Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Christmas Ornaments Memory asks you to uncover pairs of matching holiday decorations. Turn over cards, remember the ornaments they reveal, and find their partners to clear them. Complete each level before the timer expires to continue through the festive boards.

pages.title: Fashion Show Dress Up
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Fashion Show Dress Up lets you create runway and red carpet looks for a group of models. Choose dresses, combine outfits, and select hairstyles to match your fashion ideas. Use the mouse to browse the styling choices and dress each girl.

pages.title: Cool Digital Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Cool Digital Cars Slide divides car pictures into movable tiles. Slide the pieces into their correct positions to reconstruct each image. Select among three pictures and three modes to change the puzzle you want to solve.

pages.title: Vintage Cool Cars Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Vintage Cool Cars Memory hides classic car pictures beneath tiles. Turn them over and remember where each vehicle appears, then reveal matching pairs to clear the board. Try to finish all four levels using as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Cookies Match 3
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Cookies Match 3 gives you ten moves to remove the cookies requested by each level. Form matches of at least three cookies and keep track of the target quantities. Different stages change which cookies you need and how many must be cleared.

pages.title: Protect the car
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Protect the car challenges you to weave from side to side around hazards on the road. Keep your vehicle clear of whatever crosses its path and collect speed boosts along the way. Use the keyboard controls or the onscreen arrows to steer.

pages.title: Sea Treasure
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Sea Treasure has you rearrange ocean themed items to create matches. Drag and drop the pieces into groups of three or more to remove them and earn points. Search the board for another combination to continue increasing your score.

pages.title: Gun Master
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Gun Master puts you in charge of aiming at enemies and shooting them down. Line up your shots to help the hero defeat each opponent. Different guns become available as you play, giving you alternative weapons for the encounters.

pages.title: Hyper Sliding Halloween Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Hyper Sliding Halloween Party turns Halloween pictures into sliding puzzles. Move tiles into the empty space until the complete image is restored. Choose a picture and a 3 by 3, 4 by 4, or 5 by 5 grid for your challenge.

pages.title: Ball Fall
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Ball Fall asks you to guide a ball down through horizontal bars and into a bin. Watch for black dots along the bars as you choose a way through. Use the mouse to interact and keep the ball descending safely.

pages.title: Bugatti Centodieci Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Bugatti Centodieci Puzzle offers six pictures of the sports car to rebuild from jigsaw pieces. Select a 16, 36, 64, or 100 piece version, then arrange the fragments into the full image. Each photograph can be played at your preferred difficulty.

pages.title: Princess Perfect Vaction
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Perfect Vaction lets you help Emma prepare a look for her travels. Choose makeup and clothing as she explores her interest in different places, cultures, and traditions. Use the mouse to combine the available options into a vacation outfit.

pages.title: E Coupe Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: E Coupe Cars Puzzle features six car images split into jigsaw pieces. Choose a piece count from 16 to 100 and place the fragments where they belong. Reconstruct the selected coupe picture, then try another image or a larger puzzle.

pages.title: Dinosaur Hunter Survival
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Dinosaur Hunter Survival places you in a rainforest inhabited by hostile dinosaurs. Explore the environment with WASD and use your weapons to fight the creatures threatening you. Your central task is to stay alive during the encounters in the jungle.

pages.title: Fish War
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fish War has you swim through the ocean while leaving a trail of bubbles behind your fish. Use that trail to defend against other fish and capture coral flowers. Moving carefully lets you attack rivals while also cleaning the coral.

pages.title: EG Beach Restaurant
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Beach Restaurant puts you in charge of a seaside food business. Cook dishes and serve the customers who visit your restaurant, earning money from your work. Take on the manager's role while handling the kitchen and service activities.

pages.title: Music Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Music Memory Challenge hides musical pictures behind cards. Reveal them in pairs and remember which images you have seen so you can find their matching partners. Choose a level mode and keep turning cards until every pair has been found.

pages.title: Pinball Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pinball Simulator offers two tables for scoring points with a bouncing pinball. Operate the flippers to return the ball through the table's scoring features and keep it in play. Try to improve your score and place on the local leaderboard.

pages.title: NewLife
pages.creator: IncogniteGames
pages.description: NewLife is a platform adventure about jumping past enemies and reaching portals. The levels also introduce blocks you can destroy by touching them and a movable rectangle that helps with travel through the air. Use those objects to get through the obstacles ahead.

pages.title: Slide blocks Puzzle
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Slide blocks Puzzle challenges you to free a route for a designated block to reach the exit. Drag the surrounding pieces around the board, making space without overlapping them. Rearrange the layout until the target block can leave the crowded area.

pages.title: Yellow Lines
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Yellow Lines has you aim and launch a ball through arrangements of breakable yellow lines. Plan rebounds to strike the remaining targets while accounting for solid gray obstacles. Clearing the required lines completes the level and opens the next shot puzzle.

pages.title: Bonnie Christmas Parties
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Bonnie Christmas Parties asks you to create holiday looks for four themed celebrations. Help Bonnie choose an outfit suited to each invitation as she prepares to spend Christmas with friends and family. Change her styling to match the different party themes.

pages.title: Words Search Classic Edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Words Search Classic Edition challenges you to spot hidden words and highlight them before the timer expires. Scan the letter grid, find the required entries, and mark each one. Complete the searches to move through the game's levels.

pages.title: Shoot or Die Western Duel
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Shoot or Die Western Duel tests your reaction speed in a sequence of gunslinger standoffs. Wait through the countdown and fire when the shooting signal arrives. React quickly enough to beat your opponent while resisting the temptation to shoot too early.

pages.title: A Day in Angel World
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: A Day in Angel World lets you style two angels during a visit to their life in the sky. Apply makeup, choose hairstyles, and browse their dresses to create different looks. Use the mouse to select cosmetics and clothing for each character.

pages.title: Discover The Space
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Discover The Space hides stars inside space themed pictures. Examine each scene and select every concealed star to finish the search. There is no time limit, so you can take as long as you need to inspect the details.

pages.title: Sliding Escape
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Sliding Escape asks you to guide a sliding character toward each level's target without hitting enemies. Examine the arrangement and plan a safe route through it. Move carefully between the hazards to reach the goal and continue to the next puzzle.

pages.title: Couple Travel Selfie
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Couple Travel Selfie lets you style Elsa and Jack Frost for a skiing photo, then Jasmine and Aladdin for a beach selfie. Choose coordinated outfits, hairstyles, and accessories for each couple. Finish their travel looks before taking the pictures.

pages.title: Princesses Casual Outfits
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses Casual Outfits lets you put together everyday looks for a group of princesses. Browse the clothing options and combine pieces into an outfit for each character. Experiment with different combinations to give every princess her own casual style.

pages.title: Halloween Monkey Jumper
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Halloween Monkey Jumper has you guide a monkey through jumps while collecting Halloween items and diamonds in the air. Keep away from the bombs as you gather the pickups. Three bomb hits end the attempt, so each jump needs careful timing.

pages.title: Mini Putt Gem Holiday
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Mini Putt Gem Holiday takes miniature golf through festive courses filled with hazards and gems. Aim to send the ball into each hole while gathering gems along the route. Plan your shots around the obstacles and try for a hole in one.

pages.title: Kitten Match
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Kitten Match hides kitten pictures on cards for you to pair up. Turn cards over, remember the cats they show, and reveal matching partners to clear them. Keep locating pairs among the remaining cards to complete the board.

pages.title: Hip Hop Fashion
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Hip Hop Fashion asks you to dress a group of girls for a street dance competition. Select a dance outfit for the first girl, then continue styling the others. Coordinate their clothing choices to create looks for their upcoming performance.

pages.title: Sara's Cooking Class: Upside Down Cake
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Sara's Cooking Class: Upside Down Cake invites you into Sara's kitchen to prepare a dessert. Follow her directions through the recipe, gathering what you need and carrying out the cooking steps. Use the mouse or keyboard to work through the class.

pages.title: Princesses Casting Rush
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princesses Casting Rush follows Aurora, Elsa, and Cinderella as they prepare for an important audition after waking late. Pick clothing, apply makeup, and choose a hairstyle for each princess. Help them finish their preparations and get ready for the casting.

pages.title: Angie Winter Fashion Tree!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Angie Winter Fashion Tree! lets you help Angie and Tomy decorate a Christmas tree. Select ornaments and choose gifts to complete their winter display. Mix the available decorations until the tree and its presents are arranged the way you want.
